entry.title: CC v2.1.305 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces setting — given its first placemat row: Linux opt-in letting sandboxed commands create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman), loosening the sandbox's file protections
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS env var — given its first placemat row: sets the minimum interval CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG waits between checks of whether a usage limit already lifted
  • CHG allowedMcpServers — a managed-mcp.json stdio server using ${VAR} expansion only in env is now exempt from its filtering too (one using ${VAR} elsewhere is still filtered), noted on the existing deniedMcpServers row
  • CHG /artifacts delete confirmation — y/n no longer answer it; only 1/Enter (keep), 2 (delete), and Esc (cancel) do now
  • CHG /usage — each warning is now a one-line fix naming its source; press f to apply, and the same fixes surface in /doctor
  • CHG /remote-control — pressing w during spawn-mode setup now says the chosen mode is saved for the folder, and a later start using that saved mode says where it came from

entry.title: CC v2.1.304 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /auto-mode-setup — given its first placemat row: drafts auto mode environment entries from your project and recent sessions for review before saving; now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, the Claude apps gateway, and telemetry-disabled sessions
  • ADD /artifacts — given its first placemat row: lists, attaches, opens, or copies the link of artifacts you own or that are shared with you; delete confirmation now uses numbered choices
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC env var — given its first placemat row: trims pre-compaction history from a long -p/SDK session's transcript file once it passes 5MB
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW env var — given its first placemat row: sets the auto-compact window in tokens; now accepts k/M suffixes like 200k, with a warning on out-of-range or ignored values
  • ADD /claude-api managed-agents-secure subcommand — compares a Managed Agents agent's settings against Anthropic's security guide without changing anything; real and verified via the changelog, not yet in the commands reference table
  • CHG /reload-skills — compaction now resends the full skill list automatically, so this command itself sends only new or changed skills
  • CHG -w / --worktree — asks before removing the worktree and branch at exit when HEAD is detached or on another branch, so commits aren't lost
  • CHG alwaysLoad (MCP server config) — cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits on stdio MCP servers of claude.ai-synced plugins unless this is set

entry.title: CC v2.1.302 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL env var — choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; the server-side classifier's model is unaffected
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 — fork subagents (subagent_type: "fork") are now on by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already were in the terminal; set to 0 to turn them off, claude mcp serve never offers them
  • CHG permissions.defaultMode — when unset, claude -p and Agent SDK sessions now start in manual mode instead on third-party providers, with telemetry off, or on a fresh install; --permission-mode auto still keeps auto
  • CHG idleCompaction — /config now has its own Idle compaction row, and the notice shown after an idle compaction says how to turn it off
  • ADD proxyAuthHelper managed setting — read from only the highest-priority admin source, alongside apiKeyHelper and the other auth-refresh helpers; real and verified but otherwise undocumented on the reference page, so marked unverified
  • ADD additionalMarketplaces — version-gated alias (v2.1.232+) of extraKnownMarketplaces, noted on its existing row alongside allowedMarketplaces's matching alias of strictKnownMarketplaces

entry.title: CC v2.1.301 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS env var — ends an unattended CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting it out
  • ADD % vim-mode motion — jump to the matching bracket in NORMAL mode, alone or combined with d/c/y
  • ADD prependPlugins / appendPlugins settings — list an organization's mods to run before or after every mod a user installs
  • ADD worktree.location setting — choose the folder where Desktop SSH sessions create worktrees on the remote machine
  • ADD /artifact-capabilities / /artifact-diagramming / /claude-in-chrome [task] — bundled skills already documented in the commands reference, given their first placemat rows this sync
  • FIX Corrected the /fewer-permission-prompts skill row, which showed the command as /less-permission-prompts

entry.title: CC v2.1.300 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD advisorModel setting / --advisor <model> flag — pick which model answers the server-side advisor tool; /advisor reaches Claude Platform on AWS
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL env var — turn off the advisor tool entirely
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES env var — set to 0 to stop gzip-compressing large requests to the Claude API
  • CHG PreToolUse hooks — an updatedInput is now validated like Claude's own input: unknown keys are dropped, and input the tool rejects denies the call
  • CHG PermissionRequest hooks — in Cowork cloud sessions, a setMode update in the hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies
  • CHG forceLoginGatewayUrl — Claude Desktop's Code tab now applies managed settings when this names a reachable Anthropic-operated gateway serving the session's hostname
  • CHG claude-api skill — leaves Managed Agents sessions in place unless you ask to archive or delete them

entry.title: CC v2.1.299 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD idleCompaction setting / CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS env var — idle compaction now auto-compacts a 200K+ token conversation left idle for a while before its prompt cache expires; set the setting to false to turn it off
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS env var — stop expanding @ file mentions; Claude gets the paths and reads them with its own file tools
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER env var — set to 0 to drop the attribution block from the start of the system prompt
  • ADD claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator — new --shutdown-drain-sec <n> flag lets an in-flight poll and running spawn hooks finish before SIGTERM exits the process
  • ADD claude plugin eval — new --disallow-tools flag and disallowed_tools case field keep named built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs
  • CHG claude agents — a bare /model, /effort or /fast in the dispatch input now opens a picker; /effort and /fast there set what new dispatched sessions start with
  • CHG MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy — cloud sessions' and Remote Control's own MCP connectors also negotiate protocol 2026-07-28 by default now, on installs that fetch no flags

entry.title: CC v2.1.296 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD autoCompactWindow — now also settable in subagent frontmatter and --agents definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL env var — run every Workflow tool agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS env var — sets a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH — the default cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions is now 4,096 characters, raised from 2,048

entry.title: CC v2.1.295 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD onFailure: "block" hook field — a command or HTTP hook that can't start, times out, or exits unexpectedly now blocks the action instead of letting it through
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS env var — caps how long CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG waits out 429/529 errors before giving up
  • ADD forceLoginMethod: "gateway" / forceLoginGatewayUrl — now also work as your own user settings on machines with no managed settings
  • ADD /copy picker — quoted text in a response now copies without its leading > markers
  • ADD claude plugin validate — prints the install line to paste when a plugin's README has none; never fails --strict over it

entry.title: CC v2.1.293 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • ADD agentType subagentStatusLine task field — the subagent's type, the same value hooks get as agent_type on SubagentStart

entry.title: CC v2.1.292 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD claude plugin install --marketplace <source> — adds the marketplace if needed, under the same checks as claude plugin marketplace add, then installs the plugin from it
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS env var — sets a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
  • CHG MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy — local (stdio) MCP server connections now negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry included; this opts back out

entry.title: CC v2.1.290 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD claude attach <id|name> / claude logs <id|name> — part of a running background session's name now works in place of its id
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR env var — sets the hourly refill rate for an interactive session's WebSearch budget; 0 turns off refilling
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION — in an interactive session this budget now refills over time instead of ending for good once spent

entry.title: CC v2.1.288 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /code-review --max-findings <n>|all — report more or fewer findings than the usual limit; sticks until you pass --max-findings default
  • ADD Ctrl F keybinding — find a session by name in claude agents
  • ADD Alt ↑ / Alt ↓ keybindings — jump between groups in claude agents
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS env var — turns off structured outputs on Mantle or gateways that reject them, fixing session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks
  • CHG claude project purge renamed to claude purge; the old form still works and prints a notice

entry.title: CC v2.1.287 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /plugin-authoring — load Claude's reference for writing a mod, a plugin whose JS/TS hooks can draw UI and intercept tool calls
  • ADD allowManagedModsOnly managed setting — stops a user-installed mod from loading, leaving the rest of its plugin in place
  • ADD "bareElicitationCapability": true MCP server config field — needed for a server on the MCP 2025-11-25 protocol that sends URL elicitation prompts and stopped connecting after this update
  • ADD CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50 env var — restores screen reader mode's old pause before writing a new or changed line
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT — Opus 4.7+ and Fable now default to a 1M context window with no [1m] model-id suffix on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and the Claude apps gateway; this env var keeps 200K
  • CHG alwaysLoad MCP server config — set explicitly to false to defer all of that server's tools behind tool search

entry.title: CC v2.1.286 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG --bare CLI flag — connects only the MCP servers named on the command line, sends the model no system reminders, and starts no background tasks; a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
  • CHG /plugin install <name> (npm source) — refuses git-repository or folder sources, and installs the plugin's dependencies only from registry packages
  • CHG /verify — if a project or user skill is literally named verify, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits

entry.title: CC v2.1.285 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH env var — turn off the WebFetch tool
  • ADD claude --desktop CLI flag — open the Claude desktop app on the current directory, or on a session with --continue / --resume <id>
  • ADD claude plugin configure <plugin> CLI command — show a plugin's options and which are unset, or save new values read from stdin with --values-stdin
  • ADD claude plugin install --config <server>.<key>=<value> — set a bundled .mcpb MCP server's own settings at install time, so it starts without a visit to /plugin → Configure
  • ADD allowedProviders managed setting — limit which API providers a machine may use (Anthropic API, a custom endpoint, Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, or a Cloud gateway)
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES env var — cap re-sends of a non-streaming fallback request that timed out
  • CHG claude mcp get — hides the command, arguments, and environment values of stdio MCP servers provided by plugins; variable names are still shown
  • CHG alwaysLoad (MCP server config) — a tool that sets its own _meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad'] to false now stays deferred even when its server is set to alwaysLoad

entry.title: CC v2.1.284 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD effortSlider:decreaseEffort / increaseEffort / toggleUltracode keybinding actions — rebind the /effort interactive slider's step and Ultracode-toggle keys in keybindings.json
  • ADD /rate-limit-options — added to /help and the command menu for claude.ai subscribers, so usage-limit notices that mention it point to a findable command
  • CHG /effort ultracode [on|off] (also Tab in the interactive slider) — toggles Ultracode independently of effort level; no longer forces xhigh, and stays on at any effort level once enabled
  • CHG /mcp reconnect all — retries every server that failed to connect or needs authentication, in one pass
  • CHG permissions.defaultMode — when unset, interactive terminal and VS Code sessions now start in auto mode on every plan and provider; this setting still overrides that default
  • CHG /recap — declines with a short notice when relayed from a chat thread, a routine, or a webhook; typed in the terminal, Claude apps, Remote Control, -p, or an SDK host, it runs as usual
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS=0 — servers named by --allowedTools or an mcp_tool hook still get up to 2s to connect on the first non-interactive turn

entry.title: CC v2.1.283 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /doctor prompt-audit (also /checkup prompt-audit) — audits CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models
  • ADD availableModelsMatch managed setting — an exact value restricts an availableModels entry to that named version, so new releases of it stay blocked until listed
  • ADD deniedModels managed setting — blocks specific models even when availableModels allows them
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1 — also sends an x-claude-code-prompt-id header so gateways can group the requests serving one user prompt
  • CHG --system-prompt / --append-system-prompt — each now combines with its -file counterpart, with the file's text used first

entry.title: CC v2.1.282 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD maxProseWidth setting — caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals; tables and code blocks keep the full width
  • ADD allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp managed setting — let claude --chrome run alongside an exclusive managed-mcp.json; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it

entry.title: CC v2.1.281 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD attribution setting — set to false to hide all commit and PR attribution in one step; older CLI versions skip a settings file that only holds this boolean, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
  • CHG Ctrl Enter / Ctrl X Ctrl S send-now key — moves running tools to the background and sends all queued messages, instead of cancelling the turn outright
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER — also applies on a direct Anthropic API connection (1 opts in, 0 opts out); where the server-side classifier runs, it now also reviews read-only and sandboxed shell commands
  • CHG claude plugin validate — also flags .mcp.json entries that would be silently dropped at load, undeclared ${user_config.*} references, and insecure URLs

entry.title: CC v2.1.280 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH env var — change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for the session
  • CHG PermissionRequest hook — an agent-type hook no longer runs here since it has no way to return a decision; shows an error pointing to a command or http hook instead
